paragraph: Twenty-two-year-old Zoë climbed into the cockpit of a Dutch KLM jet out of Amsterdam. Her father sat beside her as captain. Her mother moved through the cabin, pouring drinks and checking seatbelts. The three of them had not planned to share this particular shift. It simply unfolded that way, the way some good days do, with all three members of one family working the same sky at the same time.
